note: vault_meetings_folder: subfolder under VAULT_PATH where meeting notes are written.
project_tags: allowed tag codes → descriptions. Claude will only use these tags.
known_customers: list of external companies. Claude also detects new ones from attendees.
employer: your company name — attendees from this org are not flagged as customers.
recap_keywords: email subject keywords to detect meeting recap emails. Set to [] to disable.
recap_lookback_hours: how far back to search for recap emails (default: 48h, since recaps arrive late).
